name: Treasure Packing
description: A hero loots a dragon's hoard with a single 25-liter, 20-kg bag. Twelve treasure categories, each with a quantity limit, value, mass, and volume — choose what to pack to maximize total value under both constraints. Scored 0–1 by value ratio against the reference packing across 20 hidden cases. Time limit 1s, memory 1 GB.
